newsitem.title: USA: Bridgestone unit to build new U.S. plant.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone unit to build new U.S. plant.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp said Monday that its Bridgestone/Firestone Inc subsidiary plans to build a new $400 million passenger and light truck tire manufacturing plant in the United States.

The location of the new plant has not yet been determined, but Bridgestone/Firestone said in a statement that it has narrowed its choice down to several sites in different states and will make a decision shortly.
The company said that no additional sites will be considered at this time and no further comment concerning site selection will be made until the ultimate site is determined.
Construction will begin immediately after the site is selected, and production is slated to begin in the spring of 1999, it said.

The plant is expected to reach production of 25,000 radial passenger and light truck tires per day in the year 2000. It is to employ between 300 and 400 people when production begins, and employment will reach about 800 people in the year 2000, the company said.
